machine: a shared 4-core machine (other jobs ran concurrently; seconds are wall-clock and noisy)

definitions.fpe: forward-pass equivalents: evaluations of the net on one input (SMC) or Monte Carlo samples
definitions.seconds: wall-clock seconds of the run (pilot included), one process per run
definitions.mc_seconds_per_sample: median wall-clock time per sample of batched plain Monte Carlo on the same net, measured in the same process
definitions.speedup_kl: Monte Carlo samples for a one-sided (1-delta) KL lower bound reaching the same ratio at empirical mean exactly p, divided by the SMC cost
definitions.speedup_task: 3 ln(2/delta) / ((1 - ratio)^2 p) divided by the SMC cost
definitions.ratio: L_bet / p (exact p for d <= 28 and the enumerated d = 32 net, else p_ref)
